privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires using the System Advisor Model (SAM). For Daggett, CA (Mojave), a 100kW DC system with 1-axis tracking should yield an annual energy production significantly higher than a fixed-tilt system (typically >250,000 kWh). The capacity factor should be high (often >25%). The DC-to-AC ratio (inverter ratio) should typically be between 1.1 and 1.3. The file must be saved specifically as a JSON at the path /home/ga/Documents/SAM_Projects/Daggett_Commercial_100kW.json.
